name: Practical evolvable structure first
statement: Structure is prioritised when it raises the chance the intent is optimally fulfilled in the optimal timeframe; the design itself keeps evolving
how_measured: Every file belongs to one component in components.csv (S1) and every component serves a solution (S19)

name: Ontology of solutions with ideals and metrics
statement: A separate defined component for every use case whose 'best' differs; each solution states what it does and its interface, has one or more ideals and a practical metric
how_measured: Every port has a solutions.csv row with an ideal and a metric or a stated gap (S7, S11)

name: Source of truth for solutions
statement: One structure records which implementation is selected, the metrics, and lets interdependent interfaces keep working while implementations change
how_measured: solutions.csv plus core/selection_table.py plus the tracker tabs (S7, S14, S17)

name: Automatic use of the best implementation
statement: The authoritative metric chooses the implementation; humans review metrics, not implementations
how_measured: The selected implementation is the leaderboard winner or a waiver names the pending decision (S10)

name: Structure improves over time
statement: The structure itself is iterated to serve its purpose and niche; what is intentionally changeable is marked
how_measured: Each solution row states its gap and action; waivers can only shrink (S7, S9)

name: High-level principles get the same treatment
statement: Problems, ideals and solutions are defined proactively for principles and behaviour, not only for artifacts
how_measured: The esoi_behavior component scores whether the AI's own behaviour follows ESOI

name: Humility
statement: Metrics decide, not opinion; alternative perspectives are implementations
how_measured: Unmeasured solutions are flagged, not assumed good (S7); challengers stay on the leaderboard

name: Leverage existing structure
statement: Use what exists (science, open source, public data, advice) and keep awareness of it only where useful
how_measured: Vendored code is a component; reference adapters and providers are reused behind ports

name: No duplication across dimensions
statement: Horizontal, vertical, topical and generational duplication is avoided where the structure's cost does not outweigh its benefit
how_measured: A port or module is defined once; role mixins; re-exports instead of copies (S4)

name: Long-term outcomes cascade to tasks
statement: Real-system tests and KPIs beat unit tests and task completion; the problem solved in the wild is what matters
how_measured: evaluation/components measures real behaviour; results.csv records provenance (S16)

name: Avoid retaining what is not useful
statement: Edit in a way that is useful next time; iterate the same files; use a scalable source of truth; no per-session files
how_measured: One registry iterated in place; scratch lives in scratch/ or /tmp (S3)

name: Minimalism and simplicity
statement: Applications of the structure specify only what differs; elegant interfaces even if complex underneath
how_measured: Configuration enters through RunnerConfig only (S13, S15); a lane is a config file

name: Clarity
statement: Naming, concise wording and organisation that lets a reader read only what they need
how_measured: Every module opens with a docstring stating its role (S5); every component states its role (S2)
